description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ClientHasBeenClosedException' used within the Fineract project to indicate that a client has already been closed. It extends a base exception class and is part of the exception handling for client-related operations.

classes.name: ClientHasBeenClosedException
classes.description: A specific exception indicating that a client has already been closed.

methods.name: ClientHasBeenClosedException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with an error code and a message indicating the client ID that has been closed.
